top_story_title: Check Point Security Management servers compromised in 22 organizations
top_story_summary: Threat actors have chained multiple vulnerabilities to compromise roughly two dozen Check Point Security Management servers belonging to 22 organizations, in a campaign reported as ongoing. The attacks were launched from 99 IP addresses and hit organizations across multiple industries and countries, and the reporting describes the campaign as AI-assisted. Neither report names the CVEs involved or a fixed build, so treat the specific vulnerability chain as unknown for now and check the Check Point advisory for the fixed release before planning an upgrade.
top_actions: Identify every Check Point Security Management server, Multi-Domain Server and log server in the estate and determine which of them accept connections from outside the management network - check the firewall rule base and any NAT or port forward to TCP/19009, 18190, 18191, 18264 and 443.
Remove management-server exposure from untrusted networks immediately: restrict SmartConsole, Web SmartConsole and API access to a dedicated management VLAN or a jump host reached over VPN with MFA.
Check the Check Point advisory for the fixed release and schedule the upgrade - the public reporting names no CVE and no fixed build, so do not assume your current version is unaffected.

Hunt on the management server: new or modified administrator accounts, unexpected API keys, changes in $FWDIR/conf and $FWDIR/log, unscheduled policy installations, cpview/audit log gaps, and outbound connections from the management server to addresses that are not Check Point update or cloud endpoints.
Review the audit trail of policy installations and object changes for the last 60 days against your change records; an unexplained policy push is the signal that matters most.
executive_summary: Lead item: multiple vulnerabilities were chained to compromise around two dozen Check Point Security Management servers across 22 organizations, from 99 source IP addresses, in a campaign reported as ongoing and AI-assisted. No CVE or fixed build has been named publicly - restrict management access and hunt now.

Cisco published three advisories for third-party code in its products - OpenJDK CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell, RCE, SIR High), PHP CVE-2026-126714 (phpAfterShell, critical RCE) and five nginx RCE flaws. All three say the affected-product list is still being compiled; none yet states fixed Cisco releases.

Broadcom shipped patches for 23 VMware vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-123903, a CVSS 9.8 authentication bypass in the vCenter directory service, with Avi Load Balancer also among the patched products - relevant to anyone whose load-balancing tier sits on VMware.
China-aligned Webworm is deploying a modified SoftEther VPN Bridge disguised as network-monitoring software for covert remote access; this is a rogue-tunnel detection problem, not a device patch.

Cisco and OpenAI released Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime in which AI agents write eBPF controls to block exploitation of unpatched flaws without restarting services. Explicitly not production-ready; watch it, do not deploy it.
key_actions: **Check Point** — Inventory every Security Management server, Multi-Domain Server and log server, and establish which accepted connections from outside the management network.

**Check Point** — Remove management-server reachability from untrusted networks now: restrict SmartConsole, Web SmartConsole and API access to a management VLAN or a jump host reached by VPN with MFA, and delete any NAT or port forward that publishes it.

**Cisco** — Inventory which Cisco products you run that embed a Java runtime - management, controller, policy and analytics platforms are the likely candidates - and record their versions ready for the moment the affected-product list is published.
**Cisco** — Subscribe to updates on the Cisco advisory and re-check it daily this week; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release rather than inferring a Cisco version from the OpenJDK fix.

**Cisco** — List the Cisco products in your estate whose administrative or captive-portal interface is PHP-based and note versions now, so the affected-product list can be actioned in hours rather than days.
**Cisco** — Monitor the Cisco advisory for updates and the fixed releases; do not derive a Cisco fixed version from the upstream PHP release numbers.
**Cisco** — Patch the nginx instances you control to 1.31.9 (mainline) or 1.30.7 (stable) as stated in the advisory, prioritising internet-facing reverse proxies and load balancers.
**Cisco** — Inventory Cisco products that embed nginx and record versions; watch the Cisco advisory for the affected-product list and its fixed releases.

ai_defenses.what_it_does: An open-source Linux security runtime, released by Cisco with OpenAI, that lets AI agents write dynamic eBPF controls to deploy temporary runtime protections against exploitation of a vulnerability, without restarting services, while administrators prepare and roll out the patch.

headlines.title: Hackers compromise Check Point Servers in 22 organizations
headlines.summary: Attackers chained multiple vulnerabilities to compromise around two dozen Check Point Security Management servers across 22 organisations in an ongoing campaign.

headlines.title: Vulnerability in Oracle OpenJDK (Java4Shell) Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco is assessing product exposure to CVE-2026-114938, an OpenJDK remote code execution flaw in Java 17.0.6 and later on x86-64 triggered by Base64 processing.

headlines.title: Vulnerability in PHP Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
headlines.summary: A critical PHP remote code execution flaw, CVE-2026-126714 (phpAfterShell), is under assessment for Cisco products; no affected products or fixed releases are listed yet.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in nginx Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
headlines.summary: Five nginx remote code execution flaws, fixed upstream in nginx 1.31.9 and 1.30.7, are being assessed for Cisco products that embed nginx.

headlines.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
headlines.summary: Broadcom patched 23 VMware flaws, including CVE-2026-123903, a CVSS 9.8 authentication bypass in the vCenter directory service, with Avi Load Balancer also among the patched products.

headlines.title: Check Point Security Management Servers Hacked in AI-Assisted Campaign
headlines.summary: The Check Point management server intrusions were AI-assisted and launched from 99 IP addresses against organisations in multiple industries and countries.
